static int evidence_thumb_calc_size (  void *  t,
int *  w,
int *  h
)  [static]
 

resize thumb-object to fit theme (after saving in standardized size).

Returns:
theme-dependent on-screen size of thumbnail in w,h
Parameters:
t - the theme (needed for icon-dimensions and resize-mode)
w - source-width (of newly-created or read-from-cache thumbnail)
h - source-height (of newly-created or read-from-cache thumbnail)
useful values for icon-mode are {w,h}/h and {w,h}/w. {w,h} means that both width and height of the thumbnail are scaled. h as a divisor indicates that the thumbnail should be as high as a normal icon, no matter what width that will result in -- this is adequate for smaller icon-sets, as it tends to prevent the thumbnails from getting too small. w as a divisor indicates that the thumbnail should be as wide as a canonical icon, no matter what the height will be. the special value "auto" will scale the thumbnail to its maximum within the bounding-box of the icon while retaining the thumbnails aspect ratio, which in real terms means, "make thumbnail as wide as an icon, unless that would mean it's higher than an icon; in this case, make the thumbnail as high as an icon instead."

icon: 32x48

icon-mode 640x480 picture 320x960 picture

{w,h}/w 32x24 thumbnail 32x96 thumbnail

{w,h}/h 64x48 thumbnail 16x48 thumbnail

auto 32x24 thumbnail 16x48 thumbnail

int thumbnail_enqueue (  file_info *  fi  ) 
 

enqueue a file for thumbnail-creation, if its format is supported.

Parameters:
fi - file_info for the item we want a thumbnail for
Returns:
If we don't know how to thumbnail a file of the given type, NOIR_TYPEMISMATCH is returned. If THUMBNAIL_IMAGES_SMALLER_THAN is set to a non-zero value and the original file's size exceeds that value, NOIR_IGNORED is returned. If an error occurs, NOIR_FAIL is returned. Otherwise, the response of thumbnail_enqueue_do() is returned.

static int thumbnail_enqueue_do (  void *  t,
file_info *  fi,
thumbnail_plugin *  tp
)  [inline, static]
 

fetches or creates a new thumbnail.

Returns:
If an up-to-date thumbnail is found, NOIR_SUCC is returned and fi->thumbfile holds the name of that thumbnail. Otherwise, NOIR_PARTIAL is returned and the thumbnail is enqueued for generation. If an error occurs, fi->thumbfile is NULL and an error-code is returned.
Parameters:
t - current theme
fi - current file
tp - what plugin to use to thumbnail this item
